Tests batch URI extraction API (extract_batch)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val configDefault = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extractBatch(listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)), configDefault)
    println(result.results.first().mimeType)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
